title: EQUITY_EW no longer self-liquidates on the second Monday
root_cause: paperloop.py run_daily_decide: after the benchmark's first fill the target_map is intentionally empty ('hold only'), and the delta=0 D7 exemption listed BENCH_CRYPTO_BOOK only, so EQUITY_EW read the empty map as target 0% and emitted sell decisions of delta = -held_weight.

fix.changed_lines: 1672-1712 (benchmark target_map/raw_map share one benchmark_bought flag; delta=0 exemption now applies to every benchmark book)
fix.net_diff: 3 hunks inside run_daily_decide: +13 / -19 lines (target_map and raw_map now share one benchmark_bought flag; the delta=0 exemption covers every benchmark book)

reproduction.harness: synthetic journal (tests/test_paperloop.py::_prepare, 2026-09-21 first Monday) + 21 appended flat daily bars, decide -> fill -> decide for three Mondays
reproduction.other_books_unchanged: fingerprint (event, book, asset, date, side, fill_status, traded_notional, delta_weight, equity) of books A / C / CRYPTO_1N is identical before vs after (52 distinct keys, 0 differences)

tests.red_proof: run against HEAD's paperloop.py (unmodified) the same test fails: second Monday sides are ['sell','sell','sell','sell'] instead of ['hold',...]
tests.related_suite: tests/test_paperloop.py + tests/test_paperloop_bench_hold.py -> 37 passed (35 existing + 2 new; includes the 6 slow milestone tests, ~9 min wall)

static_checks.ruff: new test file clean; src/yowayowa/paperloop.py has 1 pre-existing SIM113 at line 1484 (present at HEAD:1473, untouched by this card)
static_checks.mypy_ab: same-environment A/B (mypy --no-incremental): HEAD paperloop.py and fixed paperloop.py both report the identical pre-existing error set; the only paperloop.py error is the union-attr at line 1612 (HEAD:1603) 'Item None of date | None has no attribute isoformat' - unchanged by this fix, no new errors

untouched_data.note: all four verified unchanged with sha256sum -c after the fix and after the test run; real runs used temporary copies only

residual_risk: A partially rejected first-Monday buy-in (guard rejection on one symbol) leaves the book under-invested forever, because the hold-only rule freezes any later buy as well. This is the pre-existing CRYPTO_1N (D7) semantics and was deliberately left unchanged by this card; documenting it here as a separate candidate.
The fix does not re-balance drifts: EQUITY_EW is buy-once by specification, so held weights drift from 1/N over time.
